title: Design > Assembly
captureState: fixtures/research-vehicle seeded; Design > Assembly; Recovery bay selected; explode 0.6; thread 'Assembly review' with its canned exchange (S:169).
source: concepts.md §3, §4.1; spec B1 (S:160-170); plan D10, D23; BC0 critic (M1.15b)

items.text: Header bar across the top, about 56 px tall, flat, with a 1 px hairline below.
Rocket mark and the wordmark 'RocketWright' (the product name, not the art's name).
Project switcher showing the loaded project name ('Research vehicle') with a ▾ menu.
Save state with a cloud icon and a relative time computed from the real last save ('Saved … ago').
Centred tabs Design | Propulsion | Simulate | Results.
Design is the active tab, marked by a 2 px teal underline.
'✓ Check model' primary button: deep teal fill, 1 px teal border, white text; its state reflects the real model check result (status, issue count).
Settings gear button opening minimal settings.
Help '?' button.
Left rail, about 17% of the width, threads group above the page navigation section, hairline divider on its right.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, threads group; S:169 seeded threads
items.text: Thread rows with icon, name, and relative age: Assembly review, Fin revision, Flight comparison (seeded).
The selected thread row is highlighted.
'+ New thread' row below the threads.
Titled navigation section 'Components' with a search icon and '+'.
Workspace column, about 58% of the width, between the rail and the agent pane.
Docked agent pane, about 25% of the width, full height below the header, hairline divider on its left (not a floating dock).
Pane head rendered by RocketWright above the embedded chat: thread icon and the open thread's title 'Assembly review', the same thread the left rail highlights.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; S:169 allowed deviation; U17; D10; D31
items.text: 'Agent' settings button in the pane head that opens the agent's provider and model settings (the S:169 'Agent ▾' mapping).

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§2 bubble/user; D31
items.text: The user's message in a teal-tinted bubble, radius about 6 px, with the round user avatar beside it.
An `rw:` app reference in the thread renders as a chip naming the entity, not as raw text; it resolves to a stable entity id and opens that entity in RocketWright.
App tool rows for the turn's tool calls: a leading chevron that expands the call, a tool icon, the tool's label in sans, and a teal success check.
Agent reply after the turn's tool rows and cards, written as plain prose with no bubble, under the agent's name.
The embedded chat renders no thread switcher of its own; the thread list lives in the left rail.
Round user avatar beside the user's message bubble.
At least two app tool rows in the live turn, each with a leading chevron, a tool icon, a label and a trailing teal success check.
MCP Apps run card in the timeline in its narrow form: title row with a 'Saved' chip, three stats as label and value rows, and a line chart of the flight drawn in the teal accent.
Approval card attached above the composer: shield icon, an 'Approve <tool>' title, a monospace reason line, Decline and Approve buttons, and a ⋯ menu.
Chip strip above the composer input holding the `rw:c/fins` reference chip with a × remove button.
Two-row composer footer: model, effort and access controls on the first row, the context setting on the second.
The footer's access control reads Supervised, with a lock icon.
Composer pinned to the bottom of the agent pane.
Composer placeholder 'Ask about this design…'.
Paperclip attach button.
Send button.
Bottom-right footer of the agent pane states the provenance of the data shown (it replaces the art's placeholder footer).
Design history strip along the bottom of the rail and workspace.

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; C§6 (02); D10
items.text: Label 'Design history', then numbered step circles joined by hairlines, each with a name and date; numbers are sequential and unique, from the seeded history.
The current step has a teal ring.
'Compare' button at the end of the strip.
'⋯' menu after Compare.
Design local tabs Assembly | Components | Configurations, with Assembly active.
Viewport toolbar row, about 64 px, above the history strip.
'View' chips Iso | Top | Side | Front | Rear, active chip teal.
'Units' dropdown (mm ▾) that switches the displayed units.

Components tree rows named from the fixture's component tree: Nosecone, Recovery bay, Airframe tube, centering rings, Bulkhead, Parachute (stowed), Electronics bay, a single fin set row whose fin count matches the model, Motor casing, Launch lug.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, page navigation; C§4.1 Interactions
items.text: Each tree row has an eye toggle that hides and shows the part.
A hidden row (Launch lug) is dimmed with a crossed eye.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, page navigation; U14
items.text: Each tree row shows a rendered part thumbnail.
Recovery bay row selected: teal-tinted background with a teal edge; the selection is shared with viewport and inspector.
Viewport takes about 70% of the workspace.
Exploded assembly on a diagonal from upper left to lower right, every part separated along a shared axis.
Dotted shared axis through the exploded parts.
Leader labels for each part: 1 px grey leader lines with elbows and short labels.

items.source: C§4.1 Viewport; C§2 Selection in 3D; S:170
items.text: Selected Recovery bay outlined with a thin teal edge (about 2 px) and its leader label in teal.
Axis gizmo (X red, Y green, Z blue) at the top right of the viewport.
Soft vertical vignette behind the model, no grid.
PBR materials: satin white composite tubes, machined aluminium rings and motor casing, clear polymer recovery bay with an orange parachute inside, PCB-green electronics bay, swept fins.
Soft studio lighting with a contact shadow on the canvas and no bloom.
Collapsible inspector strip at the right edge of the workspace, about 225 px wide.
Inspector title 'Recovery bay ›' for the selected part.
Rendered thumbnail of the selected part.
'Attachment ›' card with Upper, Lower, and Locking rows naming the real joints from the attach graph.
'Mass ›' card with Mass, Length, and Outer dia., each with units, computed from the model.
'Clearance ›' card with Fits inside (ID), Required, and Total length, from the clearance check.
'Exploded view' slider labelled Assembled to Exploded.
Dragging the explode slider animates the explosion.
'Section' toggle switch.
The section toggle cuts the model.
'Show internals' checkbox.
'Shadows' checkbox, checked.
The thread's user requests (the earlier exchange and the live turn) appear as user bubbles; a part reference in them renders as a chip.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§5.5; U16; D7; D8; D31
items.text: Step card (an MCP Apps card in the timeline) naming the referenced design-history step from the seeded history, with an action that opens that step in RocketWright.
Clicking a part in the viewport selects it and syncs the tree row and the inspector.
An '@' action on the selected part sends it to the composer as a context chip.
Enabling 'Show internals' reveals internal parts (parachute, electronics) through the airframe.
